rule.primary_metric: mean across ten seeds of annual pooled-date RMSE in CV2024
rule.within_model: Choose D with minimum mean RMSE; numerical ties absolute tolerance1e-12 use smaller D, then parameters.
rule.neural_baseline: Choose lowest mean CVRMSE among the twelve predeclared model/D settings; same tie rules, then model name lexicographic. Persistence reported separately as deterministic reference.
rule.reserved_test: Report all twelve settings, but never select D, epochs, or baseline using their test metrics.

final_epoch_rule: Per model/D/seed reuse the selected best_epoch of the December2024 inner CV fit, fixed before test.

final_fit_policy.data: Development2023-2024 only, eligible labels u<=2025-01-01 index-D-1; retain D-day purge before test origin.
final_fit_policy.epochs: Per model/D/seed reuse the selected best_epoch of the December2024 inner CV fit, fixed before test.
final_fit_policy.seed: base seed4101..4110 supplied to helper; final refit initialization=seed+10000000, shuffle=stage seed+17
final_fit_policy.preprocessing: Fit relative-window channel scales and positive target mean only on permitted development training windows.
final_fit_policy.weights: Fresh refit per job; write configuration/checkpoint/scaler hashes before raw-test access; no test-period refits or adaptation.

test_policy.excluded: September-October2026 remain unassigned and must not be opened.
test_policy.gate: Require immutable freeze.json plus hashed final_models_manifest.json before opening any raw test ZIP or score.
test_policy.cohort: Predefined common eligible intersection across all four D, finite sigma7 and known persistence; retain full per-D eligibility/reasons and coverage, never select dates by errors.
test_policy.causal_scoring: One inference pass per saved final checkpoint; daily windows may use already observed test-period OHLCV from strictly earlier days. No test labels enter preprocessing/training/selection.
test_policy.monthly_reports: Twenty chronological reporting intervals of the same frozen final weights, not twenty retraining/CV folds.
test_policy.score_once: Resume from signed saved predictions; no test-driven tuning or reruns for performance.

limitations: Previously exposed development; no claim of a prospective pre-training pilot.
No test-driven hyperparameter or D selection.
Seed-conditional intervals do not establish population-wide generalization or equivalence.
BDS departure from iid does not uniquely identify nonlinear exploitable structure.
